groupings.title: Exploration and Planning
groupings.description: Skills for turning open-ended goals into guided discovery, planning, and execution workflows.

groupings.title: Requirements and Specs
groupings.description: Skills for creating thorough specs and requirements from early-stage ideas.

groupings.title: Long-Horizon Execution
groupings.description: A workflow that carries work from an unclear idea to a verified, reported outcome: SPECIFY → PLAN → EXECUTE ↔ REPLAN → REPORT. Start with spec-to-done, which decides whether the work warrants the loop and routes to the right stage; the stage skills also work standalone. Pair with spec-from-scratch for the specification stage.
